BillableLines.description: The ERP's record of one Billable Transport Order (a Billable line), written from the `TransportOrderBillable` event. It is Waiting until an Invoice run puts it on a Shipper invoice, then Invoiced with that invoice's number, once and only once (E1). The Freight Charge is kept as the TMS rated it; the ERP never recalculates it (ADR 0006, ADR 0012).

columns.Id: The Transport Order number, which makes recording idempotent: the same order sent again is the same line.
columns.BillingCorrelationId: Message trail of the call that recorded the line.
columns.DeliveryTime: When the Transport Order was delivered.
columns.FreightCharge: The Freight Charge the TMS rated, kept whole as JSON: its charge lines in EUR without VAT, the total and the Rate Card version it came from.
columns.IntakeCorrelationId: Message trail of the Transport Order's intake (P1), so a Shipper invoice line traces back to the booking.
columns.InvoiceNumber: Number of the Shipper invoice that invoiced the line (`INV-2026-000001`); null while Waiting.
columns.RecordedAt: When the ERP recorded the line.
columns.ReleasedWithoutProofOfDelivery: Whether Customer service released the order as Billable without a Proof of delivery.
columns.RowVersion: Concurrency token: two Invoice runs never invoice the same line.
columns.ShipmentNumber: The Shipment of the Transport Order (a logical reference to the TMS).
columns.ShipperReference: The Shipper's own reference for the order, printed on the invoice line.

CarrierCosts.description: What Norvia owes a Carrier for one Carrier booking (a Carrier cost), written from the `CarrierCostIncurred` event. It is Open until a Carrier invoice line is matched against it or Finance accepts a line for it, then Invoiced (E2). The TMS calculated it; the ERP keeps it as sent (ADR 0013).

columns.Id: The Carrier booking number, which makes recording idempotent.
columns.CarrierBookingReference: The Carrier's own reference for the booking, which is what a Carrier invoice line quotes and is matched on.
columns.Charge: The Carrier cost's charge lines and total in EUR without VAT, as JSON.
columns.CorrelationId: Message trail of the call that recorded the Carrier cost.
columns.RecordedAt: When the ERP recorded the Carrier cost.
columns.RowVersion: Concurrency token: two lines never both claim the same Carrier cost.
columns.ShipmentNumber: The Shipment the Carrier carried (a logical reference to the TMS).
columns.Source: Where the TMS got the price, as JSON: a Carrier Rate Card version or a Spot price with the Planner's remark.
columns.TransportOrderNumber: The Transport Order the Shipment belongs to (a logical reference to the TMS).

CarrierInvoices.description: A Carrier's claim for payment, as received through the Norvia Partner API, with the result of Matching each line against its Carrier cost (E2). Lines that match are accepted at once; the others wait for Finance. When every line is decided the invoice is Approved and the Carrier is told the outcome. One row per Carrier and invoice number.

columns.ApprovedAmount: Sum of the accepted amounts of the lines, in EUR without VAT; null until Approved.
columns.ApprovedAt: When the last line was decided; null until Approved.
columns.CarrierId: The Carrier that sent the invoice, taken from its token by API Management, never from the payload (ADR 0005).
columns.CorrelationId: The Carrier invoice's own Message trail, which the `CarrierInvoiceApproved` event and the outcome Logic App's reports carry.
columns.InvoiceDate: The date on the Carrier's invoice.
columns.InvoiceNumber: The Carrier's own invoice number, unique per Carrier.
columns.Lines: The lines as JSON, one per Carrier booking reference: the amount claimed, the Matching result (`Matched`, `PriceMismatch`, `UnknownBooking`, `Duplicate`), the line's status (`Matched`, `ToDecide`, `Accepted`, `Rejected`), the Carrier booking number it matched and Finance's decided amount and remark.
columns.NotToldAt: When the Carrier invoice outcome Logic App reported that the outcome never reached the Carrier; null otherwise.
columns.NotToldMessage: The technical cause of that failure, in plain language.
columns.NotToldStatusCode: The HTTP status code of the Carrier's outcome endpoint; null when the failure had none, such as a timeout.
columns.ReceivedAt: When the ERP received the invoice.
columns.RowVersion: Concurrency token: two Finance decisions on one invoice don't both land.
columns.Status: `Received` while a line waits for Finance, `Approved` once every line is decided.
columns.ToldAt: When the Carrier's outcome endpoint acknowledged the outcome; null until then.
columns.Total: The total the Carrier claims, in EUR without VAT.

CarrierRateCards.description: What Norvia pays one Carrier for transport, by Lane and weight (a Carrier Rate Card). The ERP owns it; the TMS keeps a read copy to calculate a Carrier cost at release (ADR 0013). Master data, loaded from the seed file until the sync exists (ADR 0002).

columns.LastSaveKey: The Idempotency-Key of the save that last changed the record, so that save sent again is a repeat; null until a save with a key did.
columns.Versions: Every version of the card as JSON: its validity period, Zones, Lanes, Weight Breaks and minimum charges.

Carriers.description: A transport company Norvia subcontracts to (a Carrier), as the ERP knows it. The ERP owns the Carrier; the TMS keeps a read copy (ADR 0002). Master data, loaded from the seed file.

columns.Active: Whether Norvia still uses the Carrier. An inactive Carrier keeps its history.
columns.Id: The Carrier ID (`CAR-0001`), which the other applications store.
columns.LastSaveKey: The Idempotency-Key of the save that last changed the record, so that save sent again is a repeat; null until a save with a key did.
columns.Name: The Carrier's name.

CreditNoteNumberSequences.description: The last Credit note number taken in each calendar year, so numbers (`CN-2026-000001`) run without gaps. Separate from the Shipper invoice sequence.

columns.LastTaken: The last sequence number issued that year.
columns.RowVersion: Concurrency token: two Credit notes never take the same number.

CreditNotes.description: A document that reverses all or part of one line of a Shipper invoice, with a reason (a Credit note). Final once issued, like the invoice; delivery to the Shipper is tracked the same way (E1).

columns.AmountWithoutVat: The credited amount in EUR without VAT.
columns.CorrelationId: The Credit note's own Message trail, which `CreditNoteIssued` and the Shipper invoice Logic App's reports carry.
columns.CreditNoteDate: The date of the Credit note.
columns.DeliveryDate: Delivery date of the credited invoice line.
columns.NotDeliveredAt: When it was reported that the Credit note never reached the Shipper; null otherwise.
columns.NotDeliveredMessage: The technical cause of that failure, in plain language.
columns.NotDeliveredStatusCode: The HTTP status code of the Shipper's endpoint; null when the failure had none.
columns.Reason: Finance's reason, printed on the document.
columns.SentAt: When the Shipper's invoice endpoint acknowledged it; null until then.
columns.ShipmentNumber: The Shipment of the credited line (a logical reference to the TMS).
columns.ShipperReference: The Shipper's own reference of the credited line.
columns.TotalWithVat: The credited amount with VAT, in EUR.
columns.TransportOrderNumber: The Transport Order of the credited invoice line (a logical reference to the TMS).
columns.Vat: The VAT on the credited amount, in EUR.

Drivers.description: A Driver of the Own fleet, as the ERP knows it. The ERP owns the Driver; the TMS keeps a read copy and owns Rosters, Shifts and Absences (ADR 0014). Master data, loaded from the seed file and edited by Finance.

columns.Active: Whether Norvia still uses the Driver. Making them inactive stores only this flag.
columns.FinanceOwned: True once Finance created or edited the Driver, so the seed file no longer reloads them.
columns.Id: The Driver ID (`DRV-0001`), which the TMS stores too.
columns.LastSaveKey: The Idempotency-Key of the save that last changed the record, so that save sent again is a repeat; null until a save with a key did.
columns.Licences: The licence categories held (B, C, CE) as comma-separated text, lowest first.
columns.Name: The Driver's name.
columns.Revision: The Master-data revision: 1 as loaded from the seed file, raised by every edit.
columns.RowVersion: Makes two edits at once conflict instead of both winning.

InvoiceNumberSequences.description: The last Shipper invoice number taken in each calendar year, so numbers (`INV-2026-000001`) run without gaps.

columns.LastTaken: The last sequence number issued that year.
columns.RowVersion: Concurrency token: two Invoice runs never take the same number.

OutboxMessages.description: Integration events the ERP raised in the same transaction as the change that caused them, waiting to be published to Service Bus (transactional outbox, ADR 0003). The ERP publishes `ShipperInvoiceIssued`, `CreditNoteIssued`, `ShipperInvoiceNotDelivered`, `CarrierInvoiceApproved` and `CarrierInvoiceOutcomeNotDelivered` this way.

columns.ApplicationProperties: The Service Bus application properties of the message, as JSON.
columns.Body: The event as JSON, in the Canonical Model.
columns.CorrelationId: The Message trail the event belongs to.
columns.EventId: The event's own ID, unique, so a consumer can tell a duplicate.
columns.PublishedAt: When the publisher sent it to Service Bus; null while it waits.
columns.Topic: The Service Bus topic it goes to (`invoicing-events`).
columns.TraceParent: W3C trace context of the call that raised it, so the publish continues the same trace; null when there was none.

RateCards.description: What Norvia charges one Shipper for transport, by Lane and weight (a Rate Card), part of the Shipper's Contract. The ERP owns it; the TMS keeps a read copy to rate from and never changes it (ADR 0006). Master data, loaded from the seed file until the sync exists (ADR 0002).

columns.LastSaveKey: The Idempotency-Key of the save that last changed the record, so that save sent again is a repeat; null until a save with a key did.
columns.Versions: Every version of the card as JSON: its validity period, Zones, Lanes, Weight Breaks and minimum charges.

ShipperInvoices.description: The ERP's document charging a Shipper, with one line per Transport Order (a Shipper invoice), issued by an Invoice run or Finance's Invoice now (E1). Final once issued: its number, lines and totals never change, and corrections are Credit notes. Only its delivery status follows the Shipper invoice Logic App's reports.

columns.CorrelationId: The invoice's own Message trail, which `ShipperInvoiceIssued` and the Shipper invoice Logic App's reports carry.
columns.InvoiceDate: The date of the run, Europe/Amsterdam.
columns.Lines: The lines as JSON, one per Transport Order: its number, the Shipper's reference, delivery date, charge lines and line total.
columns.NotDeliveredAt: When it was reported that the invoice never reached the Shipper; null otherwise.
columns.NotDeliveredMessage: The technical cause of that failure, in plain language.
columns.NotDeliveredStatusCode: The HTTP status code of the Shipper's endpoint; null when the failure had none, such as a timeout.
columns.RowVersion: Concurrency token: two reports on one invoice don't both land.
columns.SentAt: When the Shipper's invoice endpoint acknowledged it; null until then.
columns.Status: `Issued`, `Sent` or `NotDelivered`. Finance can send a Not delivered invoice again.
columns.TotalWithVat: The total with VAT, in EUR.
columns.TotalWithoutVat: The total without VAT, in EUR.
columns.Vat: The VAT on the total, in EUR.

Shippers.description: An organization that pays Norvia to store, move or deliver its goods (a Shipper), as the ERP knows it. The ERP owns the Shipper and its Contract; the TMS keeps a read copy (ADR 0002). Master data, loaded from the seed file.

columns.Active: Whether the Shipper is active. An inactive Shipper keeps its history.
columns.Id: The Shipper ID (`SHP-0001`), which the other applications store. It is the Shipper's identity in its token (ADR 0005).
columns.LastSaveKey: The Idempotency-Key of the save that last changed the record, so that save sent again is a repeat; null until a save with a key did.
columns.Name: The Shipper's name.

Vehicles.description: A Vehicle of the Own fleet, as the ERP knows it. The ERP owns the Vehicle; the TMS keeps a read copy and owns its availability (ADR 0014). Master data, loaded from the seed file and edited by Finance.

columns.Active: Whether Norvia still uses the Vehicle. Making it inactive stores only this flag.
columns.FinanceOwned: True once Finance created or edited the Vehicle, so the seed file no longer reloads it.
columns.Id: The Vehicle ID (`VEH-0001`), which the TMS stores too.
columns.LastSaveKey: The Idempotency-Key of the save that last changed the record, so that save sent again is a repeat; null until a save with a key did.
columns.PalletPlaces: How many pallets the Vehicle holds.
columns.PayloadKg: The most it can carry, in kilograms.
columns.Revision: The Master-data revision: 1 as loaded from the seed file, raised by every edit.
columns.RowVersion: Makes two edits at once conflict instead of both winning.
